A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fitomp]]. When a tribe of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] the world after the collapse of the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> around [[25,200 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the newcomers engaged in warfare against Fitomp's native sentients.<ref name="TUR" />
